purpose: Bracket unique file_book definitions and each done_defs emission per fixed-point pass; identify last entered definition if deadline interrupts. Includes nested work as inclusive span, not exclusive hotspot attribution.

logVolume.formula: 2Q + 2*sum(D_pass), plus existing v4 logs; Q unique file_book visited names and D_pass done_defs count for each pass. Interrupted bracket may leave one unmatched enter.
logVolume.illustration: Using2034 names across file_book plus five passes gives24408 added records; with prior max94-byte names and ~110-byte JSON fields approximately5MB additional raw. Counts/widths can grow: this is an illustration, not a cap.
logVolume.risk: Synchronous stderr write/JSON/time overhead may increase deadline interference; time bounded but no fixed byte cap. Records measure copied instrumented inclusive spans only.

reviewScope: Five additive marker insertions/exact inverse only; one focused launch review before any compiler execution.
